title: Yummy Falafel Squash Falafel
description: A winey, crisp middle-eastern dish featuring falafel made from squash and served with a side of tangy salsa for a crowd-pleaser that's low-calorie-friendly.
instructions: Chop the squash into small cubes, finely chop onions and garlic cloves.
In a large bowl, mix chopped squash, chickpeas, onions, and garlic.
Add cumin seeds, coriander seeds, sesame seeds, flaxseed meal, olive oil, salt, and pepper to the mixture; toss well.
Divide the falafel mixture into 12 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball using your hands.
Heat 1 tbsp of flaxseed oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Once hot, place falafel balls on the pan and fry for about 5 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
While frying, prepare salsa by finely chopping tomatoes, cucumbers, jalapenos (optional), lime juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Serve fried falafel with warm lettuce leaves and tangy salsa on the side.
